name: Doug Biden
source:
Doug is a rather bland person, living a mediocre existence, always blending in the background - not that he cares for the spotlight anyway. His lack of expressiveness and his monotone voice are the canned cherry on the industrial cupcake. But if he is not very charismatic, perhaps you can discover, by his side, that simple things have magic in them.

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/rendez-doug]official profile[/url]]
